summary: Ísfélag hf. engages in the fishing and processing of fish products in Europe, Asia, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Fishing and Processing. The company offers COD, haddock, saithe, capelin, mackerel, herring, capelin roe, fish meal, and fish oil products. It also provides fresh and frozen groundfish products; frozen pelagic products; and flounder and shrimp products. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Vestmannaeyjar, Iceland.
